persona_reviews.likely_action: Clicks 'Start with free review' to get fast eyes on their problem, but may bounce if no turnaround time is shown.
objections: I need a site live soon and nothing here tells me how fast a build ships.

No stated response time or support SLA for the monthly maintenance.
No way to talk to a human quickly (no phone, no 'book a call').
useful_rewrites: Add a 'Typical go-live: 7–10 days' badge to each package.

persona_reviews.likely_action: Leaves to check reviews/portfolio elsewhere; does not buy on this visit because there is zero proof.

'a proven package' is an unsupported claim with no proof behind it.

No 'no surprise fees' / 'no contract' reassurance near the price.

No client testimonials or names of businesses helped.
No social proof I could pass along to a friend.

No 'who this is for' line confirming it fits their type of business.
Monthly value not summarized in one glance.

One-line plain summaries on every feature so a busy reader gets it in 3 seconds.

objections: I don't understand the difference between 'setup' and 'monthly' or why both exist.
I'm afraid of committing to something I don't fully understand or can't get out of.
Terms like 'service stack', 'preflight', 'teardown' make me feel out of my depth.
trust_gaps: No beginner-friendly explanation of how website pricing works.
No reassurance that I can ask questions or change my mind.
Cancellation terms not visible where I'd worry about them.
useful_rewrites: Add a one-liner: 'Setup is a one-time build fee. Monthly keeps your site online, updated, and supported.'

persona_reviews.likely_action: Interested because monthly support implies an ongoing relationship; wants to confirm reliability and what 'maintenance' includes before subscribing.

Can I change tiers or add features later without starting over?

No reliability proof for the ongoing relationship (retention, longevity).
No mention of how to upgrade/downgrade between packages over time.

persona_reviews.likely_action: Wants to support a nearby independent builder but can't tell where this studio is based; engagement drops without local grounding.
objections: Where is this studio? I can't tell if they're local to me or anywhere.

No community involvement or local-client references.
No local proof to ground the 'small studio' claim.

Add 'We understand local small businesses' with a nearby-client example.

top_blockers: No proof of any kind on the pricing page — no portfolio, results, testimonials, or credentials — so trust collapses at the moment of payment.
Monthly value is never itemized; recurring fees ($50–$550/mo) read as a subscription cost rather than a defined service, and the 'optional monthly support' intro contradicts the bundled monthly fees.
Feature labels are unexplained jargon ('Review Readiness System', 'Done-for-you Setup', 'Conversion Lab', 'teardown', 'preflight') despite the page claiming pricing 'stays clear'.
The $90/mo (B) to $550/mo (C) jump causes sticker shock and confuses whether Google Ads spend is included or extra.
Risk-reversal ('Previewed before you pay', cancellation terms) is buried in footer text instead of next to the buy buttons.
No post-click clarity: buyers can't tell if 'Start this package' charges them now or starts a no-payment build.
top_trust_gaps: Zero social proof: no reviews, client logos, named businesses, or case studies.
No location or service area, so the 'small local studio' positioning has nothing to stand on.
Maintenance/monthly scope undefined (no edit limits, no response SLA, no cancellation clarity at point of sale).
No founder face/story to humanize the solo-operator advantage that the page only mentions in fine print.
No data-ownership / handover reassurance (do I keep my domain and site if I leave?).
No differentiation vs DIY builders or freelancers to justify the price premium.
